reasoning: Plan A is the superior training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates longer, more focused endurance runs (60 minutes) which are crucial for trail running, a sport that demands significant aerobic capacity and the ability to sustain effort over extended distances. Plan B, conversely, focuses almost exclusively on very short, easy runs, neglecting the development of the longer-duration aerobic base necessary for faster times. While both plans prioritize recovery, Plan A’s inclusion of a cross-training session adds a valuable element for maintaining fitness without the impact of running.
